verdict.rationale: dltHub's AI Harness explicitly lets natural-language prompts (e.g., "I want to ingest pull requests and issues from the GitHub REST API") drive coding agents like Claude Code/Cursor/Codex to build and operate pipelines, backed by MCP servers and agent-skills for inspecting/debugging/deploying pipelines. This is first-party documented and concrete, but it's an agent-harness layer rather than dlt's core library/CLI itself understanding NL, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of NL command reliability. missing for 10: independent verification of NL-command accuracy, and native NL support outside the AI Harness/agent context.
